mentions.name: In-person events platform
mentions.description: A platform for organizing and discovering in-person events, with a planned Phase 1 whose feature set includes a subset roughly similar to a well-known meetup-style app (aimed at being an improvement for the right audience) plus additional planned features. Currently in development and not yet public.
mentions.source_excerpt: The main thing I'm currently working on is a platform for organizing and discovering in-person events. Still not certain about the boundaries for "Phase 1", but I have a bunch of ideas in that space that I've been incubating for a while.
